title: Caribbean Tankers in Trouble
summary:
sanctions against Venezuela
On Monday, July 17 U.S. President Trump stated that "The United States will not stand by as Venezuela crumbles. If the Maduro regime imposes its Constituent Assembly on July 30, the United States will take strong and swift economic actions." Opponents of President Maduro's regime are highly critical of the Constituent Assembly, which would effectively have the power to re-write the constitution and strengthen the current regime's hold on power.
